subject.title: [Security] Input validation bypass in approval-classifier configuration loading

question: Does the reporter have a concrete malformed configuration that reaches `src/acp/approval-classifier.ts` and changes a prompt-required request into an automatic approval?
rationale: The public report names security-sensitive files but does not establish the attacker-controlled input, trust boundary, or observable authorization change needed to choose a safe validation owner.

options.title: Request private reproduction
options.body: Ask for the exact payload, configuration key, loading entry point, tool request, and before/after approval outcome before scoping a fix.

options.title: Close after security review
options.body: Close only if private inspection confirms that no externally influenced configuration reaches this classifier and no approval decision can be changed.

recommendation.title: Request private reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for the exact payload, configuration key, loading entry point, tool request, and before/after approval outcome before scoping a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ACP authorization and security-boundary work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the maintainer decision.
